name: Jarvis
tagline: A proactive browser extension that briefs you on your inbox, handles meeting requests and acts before you ask.

awards: Track: Agentverse - Search & Discovery of Agents

problem: AI tools wait to be asked; the team wanted an assistant that already knows the user and acts.
solution: A Chrome extension overlay reads Gmail and Calendar, gives briefings, answers or declines meeting requests and writes to the calendar, coordinated by a Python orchestrator of agents on Agentverse.
demo_moment: Team-described: open Gmail and get a briefing; a meeting request appears with accept and decline buttons inline.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Track: Agentverse - Search & Discovery of Agents” among 307 submissions.
Runs in the browser the user already has open.

lessons: An assistant that acts in the user's existing tools demos better than a new chat window.
